verdict.rationale: Twenty documents auto-generated GraphQL and REST API documentation per workspace. That documentation includes an interactive playground for executing real calls against your own data, which delivers an explorable API reference with runnable calls. The evidence is brief first-party claims only, and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec on the docs site; this suggests the reference lives inside each workspace rather than contradicting the claim. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the playground's features and prebuilt example requests, independent or hands-on corroboration, and a publicly accessible machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
